The '''Wing and Wanderer''' was the name of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Dao Stryver]] met [[Jet Nebula]] and [[Clunker]] at this cantina in [[3643 BBY]].
